extraction_notes: Datasheet identity is FDN338P, HUASHUO Semiconductor, revision Ver 2.0, with pages 1 through 5 examined.
All p-channel voltage and current magnitudes in structured numeric fields are positive magnitudes; the original signed p-channel conditions are preserved in the condition strings.

The datasheet publishes no dedicated transfer-characteristics ID-versus-VGS figure. Fig. 1 is a usable typical output-characteristics family at TJ = 25 degC with VGS curves of -1.8 V, -2.5 V, -3 V, -4.5 V, and -5 V.
RDS(on) rows transcribed from p. 2 are 89 mOhm typ and 100 mOhm max at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -3 A, and 130 mOhm typ and 140 mOhm max at VGS = -2.5 V, ID = -2 A, all at TJ = 25 degC.

The capacitance table gives Ciss = 677 pF, Coss = 82 pF, and Crss = 73 pF at VDS = -15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz, TJ = 25 degC. Fig. 7 provides usable capacitance-versus-voltage traces on a logarithmic capacitance axis.

Available additional table fields: IDSS is max 1 uA at VDS = -16 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC and max 5 uA at TJ = 55 degC; IGSS is max plus or minus 100 nA at VGS = plus or minus 12 V, VDS = 0 V; gfs is typ 12.2 S at VDS = -5 V, ID = -3 A; Qg is typ 10.1 nC at VGS = -4.5 V, Qgd is typ 2.46 nC and Qgs is typ 1.21 nC at VDS = -15 V, VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -3 A.
Available switching table fields: td(on) typ 5.6 ns, tr typ 32.2 ns, td(off) typ 45.6 ns, and tf typ 29.2 ns at VDD = -10 V, VGS = -4.5 V, RG = 3.3 ohm, ID = -3 A.
Thermal table values are RthetaJA max 125 degC/W and RthetaJC max 80 degC/W on p. 1. The datasheet lists continuous ID max -3 A at TA = 25 degC, -2.4 A at TA = 70 degC, and pulsed IDM max -12 A.

Fig. 4 gate-charge curve is digitized as total charge in coulombs and gate-source voltage magnitude in volts. Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 are normalized temperature curves and are retained as dimensionless typical curves.
No manufacturer transfer curve, RDS(on)-versus-temperature absolute curve, or capacitance table maxima/minima are published in the supplied datasheet. No vendor SPICE data was used.
omission_reason: No dedicated ID-versus-VGS transfer-characteristics figure is published, so transfer fitting is omitted. The supplied datasheet does contain usable output, on-resistance, body-diode, gate-charge, normalized temperature, and capacitance curves.
